verdict.rationale: Cooley GO runs a public guidance section with content for every stage of a business. An independent HN user confirms it has posts on FAQs such as allocating founder equity and equity incentive tax issues, and the site also offers a free public financing-data report. Missing for 10: first-party evidence describing specific formation and financing explainers, plus detail on how broad or deep the guide library is.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: Get actionable content for every stage of your business.
plus posts on FAQs like allocating initial founder equity and equity incentive tax issues
